name: Eram Garden
heritage: part of UNESCO World Heritage Site; Iranian National Heritage
text: Eram Garden (Persian: باغ ارم, romanized: Bāgh-e Eram) is a historic Persian garden in Shiraz, Iran. The garden, and the building within it, are located at the northern shore of the Khoshk River in the Fars province.

depictions.name: Eram Garden
depictions.text: is a in Civilization VII. It is associated with the Qajar civilization and must be built on a Desert tile. Effects: +4. +1 in this.
